---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      top: 6mm
      bottom: 6mm
      left: 7.5mm
      right: 7.5mm
---

```{=typst}
#set document(title: "Form 1: Historical & Pastoral Structure Recording Form", author: "Balala Heritage Project")
#set text(font: ("Helvetica", "Arial"), size: 7.3pt, spacing: 100%)
#set par(leading: 0.30em, justify: false)

// Reusable 7.5mm handwriting ergonomic primitives
#let cb = box(width: 7.2pt, height: 7.2pt, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#222222"), radius: 1pt, baseline: 1pt)

#let write-box(w: 100%) = box(
  width: w,
  height: 7.5mm,
  stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted"))
)

#let labeled-line(lbl, w: 100%) = box(width: w, height: 7.5mm)[
  #align(bottom)[
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 4pt,
      align: bottom,
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#222222"), size: 7.5pt)[#lbl]],
      [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))]
    )
  ]
]

#let comment-line() = block(
  width: 100%,
  height: 7.5mm,
  spacing: 0pt,
  stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted"))
)

#let comments-block(n: 3, label: "Additional Comments / Notes:") = block(
  width: 100%,
  above: 2pt,
  below: 1pt,
  [
    #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.2pt)[#label]
    #for i in range(n) { comment-line() }
  ]
)

#let sec-bar(num, title) = block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: rgb("#1b365d"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 1.8pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  spacing: 0pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 6pt,
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt)[#num],
      text(fill: white, weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt)[#title]
    )
  ]
)

#let sub-title(txt) = text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 7.5pt)[#txt]
#let field-lbl(txt) = text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#222222"), size: 7.5pt)[#txt]
#let note(txt) = text(fill: rgb("#444444"), size: 6.6pt, style: "italic")[#txt]

// Banner macro
#let form-banner(pg, tot) = [
  #if pg == "1" [
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      fill: rgb("#f4f6f9"),
      inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.5pt),
      radius: 1.5pt,
      [
        #grid(
          columns: (1fr, auto),
          gutter: 8pt,
          [
            #text(weight: "bold", size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[FORM 1: STRUCTURE RECORDING FORM (EXTERIOR & FABRIC)] \
            #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[
              Standing Fabric & Ruins Proforma | Adapted from Burke, Morrison and Smith 2017 & Miles Lewis (1992)
            ]
          ],
          [
            #align(right + top)[
              #text(weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[BALALA HERITAGE PROJECT] \
              #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[FORM 1 — PAGE #pg OF #tot]
            ]
          ]
        )
      ]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      fill: rgb("#e8eef5"),
      stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.2pt),
      radius: 1.2pt,
      [
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 6.9pt)[ID CODING GUIDE:] #text(size: 6.9pt, fill: rgb("#222222"))[Link all records to Master Site Map. #strong[Structure ID:] `STR-01`, `STR-02` | #strong[Room ID] (append A–Z sequentially from entrance): `STR-01-A`, `STR-01-B` | #strong[Object ID] (append 2-digit number per room): `STR-01-A-01`.]
      ]
    )
  ] else [
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      stroke: 0.8pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      fill: rgb("#f4f6f9"),
      inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.2pt),
      radius: 1.5pt,
      [
        #grid(
          columns: (1fr, auto),
          gutter: 8pt,
          [
            #text(weight: "bold", size: 8.5pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[FORM 1: STRUCTURE RECORDING (EXTERIOR & FABRIC) — PAGE #pg OF #tot] \
            #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[Structure ID: #box(width: 50pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted"))) | Structure Name: #box(width: 110pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted"))) | Date: #box(width: 45pt, height: 5.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.5pt, dash: "dotted")))]
          ],
          [
            #align(right + top)[
              #text(weight: "bold", size: 8pt, fill: rgb("#1b365d"))[BALALA HERITAGE PROJECT] \
              #text(size: 6.5pt, fill: rgb("#555555"))[EXTERIOR FABRIC]
            ]
          ]
        )
      ]
    )
    #v(1.2pt)
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      fill: rgb("#e8eef5"),
      stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#1b365d"),
      inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 1.8pt),
      radius: 1.2pt,
      [
        #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#1b365d"), size: 6.8pt)[ID CODING GUIDE:] #text(size: 6.8pt, fill: rgb("#222222"))[#strong[Structure ID:] `STR-01` | #strong[Room ID]: `STR-01-A` | #strong[Object ID]: `STR-01-A-01`.]
      ]
    )
  ]
]

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 1: HEADER, WHS, FUNCTION & LAYOUT, FOUNDATIONS
// ============================================================================

#form-banner("1", "3")
#v(1.5pt)

// 1. Header & Cross-Reference Block
#sec-bar("1", "HEADER & CROSS-REFERENCE IDENTIFICATION")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 2pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (1.2fr, 0.9fr, 1.2fr, 0.7fr),
      gutter: (8pt, 0pt),
      labeled-line("Property / Site:"),
      labeled-line("Structure ID:"),
      labeled-line("Structure Name:"),
      labeled-line("Date:")
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1.2fr, 1.5fr, 1.3fr),
      gutter: (8pt, 0pt),
      labeled-line("Recorder(s):"),
      [
        #box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm)[
          #align(bottom)[
            #grid(
              columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, 1fr),
              gutter: 3pt,
              align: bottom,
              [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt)[GNSS Point ID:]],
              [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))],
              [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt)[Poly ID:]],
              [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))]
            )
          ]
        ]
      ],
      [
        #box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm)[
          #align(bottom)[
            #grid(
              columns: (auto, 1fr, auto, 1fr),
              gutter: 3pt,
              align: bottom,
              [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt)[Site Plan No.:]],
              [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))],
              [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.5pt)[Floor Plan No.:]],
              [#box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm, stroke: (bottom: (paint: rgb("#555555"), thickness: 0.55pt, dash: "dotted")))]
            )
          ]
        ]
      ]
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1.2fr, 1.2fr, 1.6fr),
      gutter: (8pt, 0pt),
      labeled-line("Camera Make & No.:"),
      labeled-line("Photo Frame Nos.:"),
      [
        #box(width: 100%, height: 7.5mm)[
          #align(bottom)[
            #grid(
              columns: (auto, 1fr),
              gutter: 4pt,
              align: bottom,
              [#field-lbl[Overall Condition:]],
              [
                #align(bottom)[
                  #cb Good #note[(>70%)] #h(2pt)
                  #cb Fair #note[(30–70%)] #h(2pt)
                  #cb Poor #note[(\\< 30%)]
                ]
              ]
            )
          ]
        ]
      ]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #comments-block(n: 2, label: "Section 1 Additional Comments / Site Location Context:")
  ]
)

#v(1.5pt)

// 2. Safety & WHS Check
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.75pt + rgb("#b30000"),
  fill: rgb("#fff8f8"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 2pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 6pt,
      [#text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#b30000"), size: 7.8pt)[VOLUNTEER SAFETY & WHS PRE-ENTRY CHECK:]],
      [#note[Assess physical hazards before crossing building threshold or inspecting crawlspaces (Burke, Morrison and Smith 2017: 161)]]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (1.1fr, 1fr, 1.3fr),
      gutter: (6pt, 1.8pt),
      [#cb Suspected Asbestos / Fibro #note[(lagging/sheets; do not break)]],
      [#cb Flaking Lead Paint #note[(toxic dust; do not scrape)]],
      [#cb Unstable Roof, Wall Bowing, Rotten Floorboards],
      [#cb Sub-floor Arsenic, Dip, or Pesticide Hazard],
      [#cb Fauna Hazard #note[(snakes, redbacks, wasps, guano)]],
      [
        #field-lbl[Safe for Entry?] #h(3pt)
        #cb #strong[YES (Full)] #h(4pt)
        #cb #strong[PARTIAL] #h(4pt)
        #cb #text(weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#b30000"))[EXTERIOR ONLY]
      ]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #comments-block(n: 2, label: "WHS Hazards & Structural Stability Observations:")
  ]
)

#v(1.5pt)

// 3. Function, Scale & Layout
#sec-bar("2", "FUNCTION, SCALE & LAYOUT")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 2pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      [#sub-title[Category & Purpose:]],
      [
        #strong[Domestic:] #cb Homestead #cb Overseers / Cottage #cb Detached Kitchen #cb Shearers Quarters #cb Mess / Cookhouse #cb Laundry #cb Privy \
        #strong[Pastoral / Ag:] #cb Woolshed #cb Shearing Board #cb Sweat Pens #cb Stable / Tack #cb Coach House #cb Dairy #cb Meat House #cb Machinery Shed #cb Stockyard #cb Sheep Dip #cb Hut \
        #strong[Industrial / Trades:] #cb Blacksmith / Forge #cb Carpentry Shop #cb Engine / Boiler House #cb Brick Kiln / Clamp \
        #strong[Water / Services:] #cb Well Shaft #cb Underground Cistern #cb CGI Overhead Tank #cb Rivetted Ship Tank #cb Earth Dam / Tank
      ]
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, 1fr),
      gutter: 10pt,
      labeled-line("Original Purpose:"),
      labeled-line("Later / Current Use:")
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, auto, auto, auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 8pt,
      [
        #sub-title[Storeys:] \
        #cb Single #h(3pt) #cb Double \
        #cb Single + Loft #h(3pt) #cb Split
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Plan Shape:] \
        #cb Rectangular #h(3pt) #cb Square #h(3pt) #cb L-shape \
        #cb U-shape #h(3pt) #cb Multi-wing #h(3pt) #cb Open shed
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Façade:] \
        #cb Symmetrical \
        #cb Asymmetrical
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Orientation:] \
        #cb N #cb NE #cb E #cb SE \
        #cb S #cb SW #cb W #cb NW
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[External Dimensions (m):] \
        #grid(
          columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1.2fr),
          gutter: 4pt,
          labeled-line("Length (m):"),
          labeled-line("Width (m):"),
          labeled-line("Area (m²):")
        )
      ]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #comments-block(n: 3, label: "Section 2 Additional Comments / Functional & Layout History:")
  ]
)

#v(1.5pt)

// 4. Foundations & Sub-Floor Space
#sec-bar("3", "FOUNDATIONS & SUB-FLOOR SPACE (Inspect crawlspace if accessible)")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 4.5pt, y: 2pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      [#sub-title[Footings/Stumps:]],
      [
        #cb Earthfast timber posts #note[(sunk in ground; prone to rot/termites)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Timber stumps / blocks #note[(on pads; tin ant-caps post-1880)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Horizontal bedlogs #note[(logs laid on ground)] \
        #cb Dry-stone rubble piers #h(5pt)
        #cb Mortared stone foundation wall #h(5pt)
        #cb Brick piers #note[(230x230mm)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Concrete piers / slab #note[(post-1890)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Steel posts / rail tracks
      ]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.3pt + rgb("#d0d0d0"))
    #v(1.5pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (1.3fr, 1.1fr),
      gutter: 8pt,
      [
        #sub-title[Sub-Floor Bearer / Joist Conversion Marks:] \
        #cb Round bush poles #h(5pt) #cb Adzed / hewn squared #note[(scallop axe gouges)] \
        #cb Pit-sawn #note[(irregular diagonal criss-cross marks; manual two-man saw pre-1860s)] \
        #cb Circular-sawn #note[(distinct curved concentric arcs; steam sawmills post-1850s)] \
        #cb Modern milled / planed #note[(fine straight lines or smooth planed)]
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Sub-Floor Archaeological Deposit Potential:] \
        #cb High Potential #note[(intact floorboards & deep void; dropped items trapped)] \
        #cb Moderate #note[(partial floor loss, animal disturbance, sheep dung)] \
        #cb Low #note[(cleared, eroded, or washed crawlspace)] \
        #cb None #note[(earth floor or solid ground concrete slab)]
      ]
    )
    #v(1.5pt)
    #comments-block(n: 3, label: "Section 3 Additional Comments / Sub-Floor Structure & Deposits:")
  ]
)

#pagebreak()

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 2: WALLS & FRAMING, ROOF, CHIMNEYS & VERANDAHS
// ============================================================================

#form-banner("2", "3")
#v(2pt)

// 5. Walls & Structural Framing
#sec-bar("4", "WALLS & STRUCTURAL FRAMING")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.5pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      [#sub-title[Primary Wall System:]],
      [
        #cb Stud frame #note[(light dimensional timber, post-1853)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Heavy box frame #note[(mortised posts/beams, pre-1860s)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Round bush-pole frame \
        #cb Vertical split timber slab #note[(slotted in grooved top/bottom plates)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Horizontal drop-log / slab #note[(slotted into rebated posts)] \
        #cb Pisé #note[(rammed earth tamped in wooden shuttering, ~400mm lifts)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Wattle & daub / Pug & pine #note[(saplings plastered with mud/straw)] \
        #cb Mudbrick / Sun-dried adobe #h(5pt)
        #cb Solid Brick #h(5pt)
        #cb Cavity Brick #note[(tied double leaf, post-1880s)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Stone Masonry #h(5pt)
        #cb CGI on timber frame
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.3pt + rgb("#d0d0d0"))
    #v(2pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (1.2fr, 1.2fr),
      gutter: 8pt,
      [
        #sub-title[Timber Joints Observed:] \
        #cb Mortise & tenon #note[(traditional carpentry)] #h(5pt) #cb Pegged / drawbore #note[(trunnels)] \
        #cb Halving / notched lap #h(5pt) #cb Bird’s mouth rafter notch #h(5pt) #cb Butt & nailed #note[(post-1853)]
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Fasteners & Nails Observed:] \
        #cb Hand-wrought nails #note[(square tapered shank, rosehead; pre-1850s)] \
        #cb Machine-cut / Ewbank #note[(wedge taper on 2 sides; c.1835-1880s)] \
        #cb Wire nails #note[(circular drawn wire shank, flat head; post-1870s)] #h(5pt) #cb Baling wire
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.3pt + rgb("#d0d0d0"))
    #v(2pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      [#sub-title[Brick & Stone Details:]],
      [
        #strong[Brick Mfg:] #cb Handmade/sandstock #note[(creases, thumb marks, no/shallow frog; pre-1850s)] #h(3pt) #cb Machine-pressed #note[(crisp edges, deep frog; post-1855)] \
        #strong[Brick Bond:] #cb Stretcher #cb English #note[(alt rows header/stretcher; strong)] #cb Flemish #note[(alt header/stretcher in row)] #cb Colonial #note[(3-5 stretchers per header)] \
        #strong[Stone Coursing:] #cb Ashlar #note[(dressed square blocks, fine joints)] #cb Coursed rubble #note[(distinct rows)] #cb Random uncoursed rubble #note[(no rows)] \
        #strong[Mortar:] #cb Soft lime-sand #note[(buff/white, scratches with fingernail)] #cb Mud / clay #cb Hard grey Portland cement #note[(post-1880s)] \
        #strong[Quoins:] #cb Dressed stone #cb Contrasting brick #cb Rendered rusticated #cb None
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.3pt + rgb("#d0d0d0"))
    #v(2pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      [#sub-title[Cladding & Finishes:]],
      [
        #cb Weatherboard beaded #note[(quirked edge bead; pre-1860)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Weatherboard plain splayed #note[(no bead; post-1860)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Rough-sawn boarding \
        #cb CGI 5-inch / 130mm early pitch #note[(heavy gauge, 1850-65)] #h(5pt)
        #cb CGI 3-inch / 80mm standard pitch #note[(dominant post-1860)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Ripple iron #note[(25mm flutes; post-1890)] \
        #cb Flattened tin plate #note[(kerosene tins)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Fibro / Asbestos cement + battens #note[(post-1903)] #h(5pt)
        #cb Limewash #h(5pt)
        #cb Stucco / render #h(5pt)
        #cb Roughcast
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #comments-block(n: 4, label: "Section 4 Additional Comments / Fabric & Framing Notes (species, scars, tool marks):")
  ]
)

#v(2pt)

// 6. Roof, Chimneys & Verandahs
#sec-bar("5", "ROOF, CHIMNEYS & VERANDAHS")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.5pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (auto, 1fr),
      gutter: 5pt,
      [#sub-title[Roof Form & Cladding:]],
      [
        #strong[Form:] #cb Gable #h(3pt) #cb Hipped #h(3pt) #cb Half-hipped / Jerkinhead #h(3pt) #cb Skillion #h(3pt) #cb Curved / Bullnose #h(3pt) #cb Monitor / Sawtooth \
        #strong[Current Cladding:] #cb Corrugated iron (CGI) #h(3pt) #cb Wood shingles #h(3pt) #cb Split palings #h(3pt) #cb Stringybark #h(3pt) #cb Slate #h(3pt) #cb Marseilles tile \
        #strong[Roof Space Clues (inspect cavity):] #cb Shingle battens with nail holes #cb Remnant shingles/bark in attic #cb Sawing change
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.3pt + rgb("#d0d0d0"))
    #v(2pt)
    #grid(
      columns: (1.3fr, 1.1fr),
      gutter: 8pt,
      [
        #sub-title[Verandahs & Skillions:] \
        #strong[Location:] #cb Front #cb Rear #cb Sides #cb All around #cb None \
        #strong[Roof Profile:] #cb Straight skillion #cb Broken-back pitch #cb Bullnose #cb Concave / Ogee \
        #strong[Posts:] #cb Bush pole #cb Square plain #cb Chamfered #cb Turned timber #cb Cast iron \
        #strong[Status:] #cb Original #cb Added later #cb Partially enclosed #cb Fully enclosed as rooms
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Chimneys & Fireplaces:] \
        #grid(
          columns: (1fr, 1fr),
          gutter: 6pt,
          labeled-line("Standing Stacks:"),
          labeled-line("Remnant Hearths:")
        )
        #v(1pt)
        #strong[Material:] #cb Brick #cb Stone/rubble #cb CGI sheet stack \
        #cb Split slab & mud/pug #cb Concrete / pipe \
        #strong[Location:] #cb External gable #cb Internal wall #cb Corner \
        #strong[Detail:] #cb Corbelled cap #cb Chimney pot #cb Plain
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #comments-block(n: 3, label: "Section 5 Additional Comments / Roof & Verandah Notes (flashing lines, alterations):")
  ]
)

#pagebreak()

// ============================================================================
// PAGE 3: OPENINGS, BRANDS, PHASING & SYNTHESIS
// ============================================================================

#form-banner("3", "3")
#v(2pt)

// 6. Exterior Openings
#sec-bar("6", "EXTERIOR DOORS & WINDOWS (Summary across structure)")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 5pt, y: 2.5pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (1.2fr, 1.2fr),
      gutter: 10pt,
      [
        #sub-title[Windows:] \
        #strong[Type:] #cb Double-hung sash #cb Casement #cb Sliding horizontal #cb Fixed #cb Shutter only #cb Louvre \
        #strong[Panes:] #cb 12-pane (6/6) #note[(pre-1865)] #cb 6-pane #cb 4-pane (2/2) #note[(1865-1900)] #cb 2-pane (1/1) #cb Single large \
        #strong[Lintel / Sill:] #cb Timber head / sill #cb Brick flat/segmental arch #cb Stone lintel / sill
      ],
      [
        #sub-title[Doors & Hardware:] \
        #strong[Type:] #cb Ledged & braced #cb 4-panel Victorian #cb 6-panel Colonial #cb High-waisted \
        #cb French doors (pair glazed) #cb Half / stable door #cb Large sliding shed door \
        #strong[Hardware:] #cb Rim lock (surface box) #cb Mortise lock #cb Thumb latch #cb Drop-bar #cb Strap hinges #cb Butt hinges
      ]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #comments-block(n: 3, label: "Section 6 Additional Comments / Openings Notes (blocked apertures, hardware brands):")
  ]
)

#v(2pt)

// 7. Brands & Marks
#sec-bar("7", "BRANDS, MAKER’S MARKS & EXTERIOR INSCRIPTIONS")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 2.5pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #set table(inset: (x: 3pt, y: 0pt), stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#b0b0b0"))
    #table(
      columns: (1fr, 1.3fr, 2.2fr, 0.7fr),
      fill: (col, row) => if row == 0 { rgb("#e8eef5") } else { white },
      align: (col, row) => if row == 0 { left + horizon } else { left + bottom },
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Location / Fabric]],
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Item / Feature Type]],
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Exact Text / Brand / Symbol Observed (e.g. Lysaght Orb, Patent Diamond)]],
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Photo No.]],
      write-box(), write-box(), write-box(), write-box(),
      write-box(), write-box(), write-box(), write-box(),
      write-box(), write-box(), write-box(), write-box(),
      write-box(), write-box(), write-box(), write-box()
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #comments-block(n: 2, label: "Section 7 Additional Comments / Inscription Details:")
  ]
)

#v(2pt)

// 8. Phasing Log
#sec-bar("8", "COMPONENT & ADDITION PHASING LOG (Miles Lewis 1992 Building Developments)")
#block(
  width: 100%,
  stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#a0a0a0"),
  inset: (x: 4pt, y: 2.5pt),
  radius: 1.2pt,
  [
    #set table(inset: (x: 3pt, y: 1.5pt), stroke: 0.35pt + rgb("#b0b0b0"))
    #table(
      columns: (1.2fr, 1.4fr, 2.3fr, 1fr),
      fill: (col, row) => if row == 0 { rgb("#e8eef5") } else { white },
      align: (col, row) => if row == 0 { left + horizon } else { left + top },
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Construction Stage]],
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Rooms / Fabric Included]],
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Physical Clues Observed (Check all indicators present)]],
      [#text(weight: "bold", size: 7.2pt)[Estimated Date / Era]],

      [#strong[Stage 1: Original Core] \ #note[Primary footprint & frame]],
      [#write-box()],
      [
        #cb Vertical seam / crack in wall #h(4pt) #cb Continuous plates/bearings \
        #cb Consistent pit/circular timber marks #h(4pt) #cb Early nails (wrought/cut)
      ],
      [#write-box()],

      [#strong[Stage 2: Early Addition] \ #note[Rear skillion, kitchen link, wing]],
      [#write-box()],
      [
        #cb Unbonded vertical joint / crack #h(4pt) #cb Change in brick/timber type \
        #cb Roof framing break / batten change #h(4pt) #cb Floor step / board width shift
      ],
      [#write-box()],

      [#strong[Stage 3: Modification] \ #note[Verandah infill, re-roofing CGI]],
      [#write-box()],
      [
        #cb Flashing line / crease on wall #h(4pt) #cb CGI over shingle battens \
        #cb Blocked door / window aperture #h(4pt) #cb Removed partition joist scar
      ],
      [#write-box()],

      [#strong[Stage 4: Modern Repairs] \ #note[Steel posts, concrete, salvage]],
      [#write-box()],
      [
        #cb Wire nails / Portland cement patch #h(4pt) #cb Steel pipe / angle iron \
        #cb Fibro / Masonite lining #h(4pt) #cb Machine removal / salvage scars
      ],
      [#write-box()]
    )
    #v(2pt)
    #comments-block(n: 3, label: "Section 8 Additional Comments / Phasing Observations & Structural Junctions:")
  ]
)

#v(2pt)

// 9. Synthesis & Archaeological Potential
```
